entity.name: ProgrammingGuide
entity.deletedPkQuery: select Id from ProgrammingGuide WITH(NOLOCK) where IsDeleted='true'

entity.name: ProgrammingGuideMedia
entity.query: select MediaId from ProgrammingGuideMedia WITH(NOLOCK) where ProgrammingGuideId='${ProgrammingGuide.Id}'

entity.name: Media
entity.query: select Id,SizesPaths from Media WITH(NOLOCK) where Id='${ProgrammingGuideMedia.MediaId}'

entity.name: ProgrammingGuideNode
entity.query: select NodeId from ProgrammingGuideNode WITH(NOLOCK) where ProgrammingGuideId='${ProgrammingGuide.Id}'

entity.name: Node
entity.query: select Id from Node WITH(NOLOCK) where Id='${ProgrammingGuideMedia.NodeId}'

entity.name: NodeProgram
entity.query: select Id, Description from Node WITH(NOLOCK) where Id='${ProgrammingGuide.NodeId}'

entity.name: ProgramGallery
entity.query: select GalleryId from ProgramGallery WITH(NOLOCK) where ProgramId='${ProgrammingGuide.Id}' order by [Order]

entity.name: ProgrammingGuideChannel
entity.query: select Channel from ProgrammingGuide WITH(NOLOCK) where Id='${ProgrammingGuide.Id}'

entity.name: ChannelInfo
entity.query: select Id,Name from Channel WITH(NOLOCK) where Id='${ProgrammingGuide.Channel}'
